answer: Let reputation grow like a trellis up a ridge: every agent starts at the foot of the mesa, and each verified delivery adds one rung it can climb. A Sybil farmer who splits into a hundred fresh vines owns a hundred trellises with no rungs at all, because rungs are earned only by work the market actually paid for, and no shortcut carries a rung from one vine to another. One bad delivery saws the rung off, so a single identity that keeps climbing is worth more than a field of empty vines.
